Fluffy Pancakes

4 servings · prep 10 min · cook 15 min · American

Ingredients

  • 200 g Flour
  • 2 tsp Baking powder
  • 1 tbsp Sugar
  • 1 pinch Salt
  • 300 ml Milk
  • 2 Eggs
  • 2 tbsp Butter, melted, plus extra for the pan
  • Maple syrup, to serve (optional)

Steps

  1. Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt in a large bowl.
  2. In a jug, beat the milk, eggs and melted butter together. Pour into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined; a few lumps are fine.
  3. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and wipe with a little butter.
  4. Pour in about 3 tablespoons of batter per pancake. Cook for 2 minutes until bubbles appear, flip and cook 1 minute more.
  5. Keep warm in a low oven while you cook the rest. Serve with maple syrup or fruit.
